text: Reading Passage 1 has five paragraphs, A-E.
Which paragraph contains the following information?

items: mention of several challenges to be overcome before a green roof can be installed <input>
reference to a city where green roofs have been promoted for many years <input>
a belief that existing green roofs should be used as a model for new ones <input>
examples of how green roofs can work in combination with other green urban initiatives <input>
the need to make a persuasive argument for the financial benefits of green roofs <input>

City rooftops covered with greenery have many advantages. These include lessening the likelihood that floods will occur, reducing how much money is spent on <input> and creating environments that are suitable for wildlife. In many cases, they can also be used for producing <input>.

There are also social benefits of green roofs. For example, the medical profession recommends <input> as an activity to help people cope with mental health issues. Studies have also shown that the availability of green spaces can prevent physical problems such as <input>.
body.title: Advantages of green roofs
Which TWO advantages of using newer buildings for green roofs are mentioned in Paragraph C of the passage?
options: a longer growing season for edible produce
ability to cultivate more plant types
a large surface area for growing plants

body.title: Which TWO aims of new variations on the concept of green roofs are mentioned in Paragraph E of the passage?
options: to provide habitats for a wide range of species
to grow plants successfully even in the wettest climates
to regulate the temperature of the immediate environment
to generate power from a sustainable source
to collect water to supply other buildings
